name: Partnership
overview: Scripture reveals that partnership is grounded in unity and mutual agreement, as Amos 3:3 teaches that two cannot walk together unless they are agreed. This principle applies to human relationships, where Proverbs 27:17 illustrates how friends sharpen one another, and Ecclesiastes 4:9 highlights the greater reward found in working together. Above all, true partnership with God is assured by His presence and power, as Joshua 1:9 and Luke 1:37 affirm that God is with His people wherever they go and that nothing is impossible with Him. Jeremiah 29:11 further encourages trust in God's good plans, underscoring the hope and strength found in partnership with the Lord.
